body:
Blog post: https://huggingface.co/blog/ggml-org/llama-cpp-v1

llama.cpp v1.0.0 removes the deprecated public API and promotes the NextN/speculative API to llama.h , adds OCP FP8 KV caches, a host-memory MoE expert cache with a configurable CPU share, and loading of external PLE shards. It adds three text architectures (Kimi-K3.1-Pro, Ripple and xing4_0), drama-3 TTS, and MageVL-Cowork and Kimi-K3.1 vision, hardens llama-server (SSRF, CORS, DNS rebinding, MCP tool cancellation) and adds a /v1/audio/speech endpoint, ships a redesigned web UI with chat groups and a markdown editor, and updates ggml to v1.0.0.

- llama.h: remove llama_set_warmup , 35 deprecated functions, defrag_thold and --defrag-thold ( #30565 )

- llama.h: promote the NextN API from llama-ext.h and rename llama_set_embd_state_src to llama_set_ctx_state_src ( #30565 )

- llama.h: add moe_cache_size and moe_cache_cpu_share to llama_context_params ( #30966 )

- mtmd.h: add MTMD_GEN_AUDIO_TYPE_DRAMA3 and temp in mtmd_helper_gen_audio_inp ( #31613 , #31655 )

- mtmd-helper.h: add mtmd_helper_resampler for streaming raw PCM at the model sample rate ( #31964 )

- server: add the OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint and a temperature option for /tts ( #31763 , #31655 )

- Kimi-K3.1-Pro: K3 with the full-attention MLA layers replaced by DSA ( #31779 )

- Ripple-65B-Preview ( ricursive ): new dense 65B architecture, no new ops ( #31692 )

- xing4_0: mHC, MLA, MoE and MTP ( #31589 )

- drama-3 TTS (fishaudio) ( #31613 )

- FP8 KV caches ( -ctk/-ctv f8_e4m3 ) with optional static per-tensor scales ( #28392 )

- MoE cache: CPU share for misses, LRFU/ClassLRU replacement, no CPU wait on cached experts ( #30966 , #31233 , #31888 )

- external PLE/engram loading from separate GGUF shards via --shard / --ple ( #31185 )

- Windows unbuffered model load, mirroring the Linux DirectIO path ( #26014 )

- reuse the backend scheduler and graph results across reserves, and skip unused graph metadata pages ( #32009 , #32089 , #32043 )

- mark every sampling chain as a graph output to prevent output aliasing ( #32015 )

- remove the non-fused GDN paths and the ubatch-dependent graph node budget ( #32078 )

- store the MTP conv snapshots of every recurrent model in one set_rows ( #31660 )

- per-model build_rope with a KV-shifting fix and tests ( #31683 ); the model is a member of llm_graph_context ( #31733 )

- fix on-device state copy sizes for quantized KV caches ( #30541 )

- follow the reference precision of ggml_prec_set_acc call sites ( #31851 )

- attach NVFP4 FFN scales in Granite and qwen2 ( #31449 , #31657 ); merge tensors on convert for qwen3.5 ( #32102 )

- apply the iGPU lazy-mode fallback only when mmap is off ( #31957 )

- fit: account for skipped NextN layers when setting n_gpu_layers ( #31569 )

- jinja: chained comparisons and argument unpacking ( #32072 ); TTS text normalization via the chat template ( #32053 )

- chat: honor response_format in the qwen3-coder/deepseek/ministral3, Muse Spark and gemma4 parsers ( #31956 , #32017 , #31915 )

- json-schema: fix allOf of plain types ( #31834 ); escape control characters and sanitize invalid UTF-8 in tool arguments ( #31937 , #31861 )

### Multi-modality changes

- remove clip.h and consolidate the model/subcontext infrastructure into mtmd ( #31865 )

- share the compute buffer among subcontexts to save memory for vision+audio+gen models ( #31945 )

- compute log-mel in the graph instead of spawning threads per request ( #31808 )

- support Gemma 4 streaming audio input ( #31965 )

- support MageVL-Cowork ( #31819 ) and Kimi-K3.1 vision ( #31980 )

- require the projector and patch embedding tensors and a 2x2 spatial merge at load ( #32129 , #32130 )

- require an F32 position embedding for HunyuanVL and read the MiniCPM-V width from ne[1] ( #32131 , #32132 )

- security: add --allow-unauthenticated-tools and --media-allow-private-urls opt-ins ( #32113 , #32115 )

- security: fix --cors-origins , DNS rebinding, CORS proxy SSRF and child instance access ( #32098 , #32115 , #32120 )

- restrict the HF_TOKEN to huggingface.co hosts ( #31730 )

- cancel MCP tool calls on client disconnect or timeout and notify the MCP server ( #32025 )

- keep the server awake while a request uses its state with --sleep-idle-seconds ( #32133 )

- use reference-counted context checkpoints instead of deep copies ( #30137 )

- visit parent slots before child slots for shared-prefix requests ( #30779 )

- realtime API: send error events instead of crashing, reject non-object session updates, fix the output lang ( #31632 , #31714 , #31982 )

- accept the top-level response_format.schema form and convert Responses text.format JSON schemas ( #28697 , #26145 )

- sidebar: fold, preview and rearrange sections ( #31936 ) and gather chats into named groups ( #32012 )

- move Models, MCP and Settings to a sidebar footer, with full-screen pages on phones ( #32022 )

- mobile: native layout, safe areas and full-screen dialogs ( #31949 )

- open the virtual keyboard in the chat editor on Android ( #32060 )

- chat input: live-preview markdown editor that expands for long messages ( #31955 , #31973 )

- open the actions menu on right-click for chats, tabs, messages and models ( #31545 )

- PDF attachments: show text and page thumbnails, stop endless conversion retries ( #31468 )

- Discover: show audio capability from the mmproj ( #31837 ) and keep downloads during search ( #31467 )

- add a search_chats tool ( #32051 ) and move the JS sandbox setting out of developer ( #32054 )

- take the logo and favicons from the llama-brand package ( #32039 , #32112 )

- fix a hidden sidebar intercepting clicks ( #31712 , #32035 )

- v1.0.0 : ggml 1.0.0 prunes the deprecated public API and the legacy DIAG_MASK ops, adds configurable YaRN truncation and FP8 support, and brings broad performance work across backends: few-row quantized matmuls and MoE fusion on CUDA/Metal, a Vulkan prefill FlashAttention path, a device-side MoE scheduler on SYCL, decomposed Adreno FlashAttention in OpenCL, new WebGPU kernels, expanded Hexagon op coverage, and scheduler improvements that avoid uploading unused inputs.

- Releases and versioning of ggml-org projects
